title: BLDC Configuration
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Electrical Systems/Motors/BLDC_Configuration.md
text: Configure BLDC system parameters, 1 output; {Mechanical input configuration} selects port configuration, {Sample Time (Ts)} sets the sample time after which block executes again, {Number of pole pairs} sets the pole pairs, {Stator resistance per phase (Ohm)} sets the resistance of stator, {Stator d-axis inductance (H)} sets the d -axis inductance 1.7e-3, {Stator q-axis inductance (H)} sets the q -axis inductance 3.2e-3, {Permanent flux linkage constant (Wb)} sets the flux linkage constant, {Inertia (kgm^2)} sets the physical inertia, {Viscous damping (Nm/rad/s)} sets the viscous damping 4.924e-4 and {Static friction (Nm)}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sample Time (Ts)
params.values: Sample time after which block executes again 1e-6 (default) | scalar
